firstPlayerRule: In the players' first game, the youngest player is the first player. Otherwise, reveal cards from the destiny deck until one matches a player's color; that player is the first player. Then shuffle the destiny deck.
clarifications: Players take turns in clockwise order starting with the first player; on each turn the active player has an encounter.
